purpose: Supporting internal regression and extended numerical campaign design, excluded from the canonical 100 external scientific comparisons; no test execution is asserted.

status_definitions.existing_test: A corresponding assertion/fixture was inspected in an existing test or validation entrypoint; the current campaign must still run it and retain evidence.
status_definitions.existing_capability: Existing solver or suite supports the quantity, but the full stated acceptance specification needs an adapter or additional evidence.
status_definitions.planned_adapter: Case is specified; implementation and execution remain pending.

runtime_tiers.T0: Initial budget <=2 CPU minutes per case, excluding Julia compilation; unmeasured.
runtime_tiers.T1: Initial budget 2-15 CPU minutes per case, excluding compilation; unmeasured.
runtime_tiers.T2: Initial budget 15-120 CPU minutes per case; pilot timing required.
runtime_tiers.T3: Initial budget 2-24 CPU hours per multi-arm case; pilot timing and convergence may require revision. These are planning budgets, not measured finish estimates.

statistical_policy.multiple_testing: Let C be the full preregistered number of scalar stochastic comparisons, including all matrix entries/parameter arms. Use Bonferroni alpha=0.01/C and Student-t or a validated simultaneous block-bootstrap interval, not a fixed two-sigma gate. C must be frozen in the execution manifest.
statistical_policy.equivalence: PASS only when the entire simultaneous CI for estimate minus independent oracle lies inside the stated +/- margin after separately accounting for bounded systematic errors. A wide CI, unstable blocking, low ESS, unresolved denominator, missing result or timeout is UNRESOLVED.
statistical_policy.sampling: At least 8 independent seeds for new Monte Carlo benchmarks, >=32 effectively independent blocks and estimated ESS>=1000 per scalar; select block length >=10 estimated integrated autocorrelation times using a pilot excluded from validation. Record raw numerator and denominator bins.
statistical_policy.paired_data: Keep sign numerator/denominator and within-node plus/minus bins paired during jackknife/bootstrap. Preserve covariance for common seeds or coupled methods. Independent nodes may combine variances only after independence has been established.
statistical_policy.fixed_protocol: Register stopping rule, burn-in, fit order, run length, error margins, seeds and comparison count before looking at validation data. Do not rerun until a p-value passes or inflate errors after disagreement.
statistical_policy.bias: Thermal, finite-dtau, incomplete optimization, truncation, sign and sampling error are distinct. Compare finite-dtau DQMC with the same thermal action; extrapolate to continuum or show a separate bias bound before comparing to ground-state ED/DMRG.
